_comment: The MEASURED class of every benchmark of the model-driven set (D18, T0.11): what DiscoPoP plus the gate does on it with no model, over three independent profile draws. R = no draw reaches a verified parallel program (needs restructuring); A = the majority do (parallel as written); D = R by measurement AND a true recurrence by design (the reference solution is the sequential program). This file is campaign INPUT: E1's benchmark lists and the per-class read-out of the main comparison come from it. It replaces the guessed groups of kernel_groups.json (A/B/C, fixed 14 Sep before anything was measured), which stay only for the archived pilots and E10.
source: results/T0_instruments/T0.11_measured_classes/analysis/classes.csv (runs t0_11_classes_a/b/c, 2026-09-20/21); the eight TSVC indirect-addressing loops of the author's decision 8 from runs t0_11_probe_a/b/c (2026-09-25, results/T0_instruments/T0.11_measured_classes/runs/): 3 of 3 draws FASTER each — class A
e1_repeats_why: the claim (C1) is about R; A shows 'no harm'; D shows 'no unsafe acceptance' (record §5k)

excluded.polybench/adi: D25: 2,387 s per profile (L4); one draw only, class left undetermined

tsvc_b1_note: E1-final (2 Oct) runs E1c's population repackaged in v4 (tsvc_b1): each package takes the class its loop measured in the v3 packaging (T0.11) — the loop is the same text; E1-final's own DiscoPoP-alone arm (discopop_gate_v3) re-measures it on every trial (class R 0 of 90 verified parallel, class A 3 of 3 FASTER, class D 0 of 12). Added 3 Oct, before any E1-final read-out.
tsvc_c1_note: Packaging v5 (4 Oct): every tsvc_c1 package's class is MEASURED on the new packages — three draws of discopop_capability (t0_11_c1_a/b/c; results/T0_instruments/T0.16_clean_layout/analysis/classes/), every loop the same in 3 of 3 draws: R 30, A 8, D 4. E1-final's population keeps its classes (18 R, 3 A, 4 D). s482 is R here: DiscoPoP reports its loop Do-All in this layout, and its pragma on a loop with a `break` does not compile.
